title: A Night at the Opera
sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories
description: Deterministic AdventureModule for the first Tales of the RED mission. Beat flow, sealed GM truth and player-owned investigation are persisted independently of narration.
recommendedCharacters: Edgerunner crew able to investigate, socialize, infiltrate and confront dangerous opposition.
premise: A wealthy Rocklin Augmentics executive offers the Crew a recovery job after his daughter becomes the latest of seven missing women.
publicBackground: Seven women have vanished from the University District over four weeks; Lucy Rhinemeyer is the latest.
gmBackground: Lord Ruthven, an ex-Philharmonic Vampyre who has become cyberpsycho, is responsible. The Master covertly arranged the Crew's involvement to solve the problem without exposing the gang's connection.
openingSituation: The Crew receives the contract offer: 2,000eb per Edgerunner, with 500eb on signing and the remainder after Lucy is recovered, whatever her condition.

startDefinition.openingSituation: The Crew receives the Lucy Rhinemeyer recovery contract and the lead toward a Philharmonic Vampyres gathering.
